subject: Music Production
title: Lossy vs Lossless Compression
description: A short lesson to help you apply Lossy vs Lossless Compression.

hook.text: An uncompressed three-minute song takes about thirty megabytes of storage space.

buildup.text: MP3 compression shrinks files by removing audio data that humans are unlikely to notice.

discovery.text: Lossy formats like MP3 discard information permanently, while lossless formats like FLAC keep it all.

twist.text: Most listeners in blind tests cannot distinguish a high-quality MP3 from an uncompressed file.

climax.text: Producers always work with lossless audio and only convert to lossy for final distribution.

punchline.text: Smaller files sacrifice sounds most ears never hear.

quiz.question: What is the key difference between lossy and lossless compression?
options: Lossy discards data permanently, lossless keeps it all
